content: Medical equipment rental platforms (Rentrax, Rentablez, Reservety, Booqable, Renttix). Features: serialized unit inventory with per-device service/sanitization history; availability calendar + double-booking prevention; delivery/pickup scheduling (window/route); security deposits held separately; recurring monthly billing for open-ended rentals; rental agreement e-signature at door; condition photos; maintenance/service blocks unit from re-allocation; consumables as bulk stock; warranty/serial tracking; customer portal for invoices/payments.
